description: Calculates power, current (total and per channel), required feed points, power-supply size and the extra-low-voltage feed cable for an analogue LED strip (5/12/24/48 V DC; single colour, CCT, RGB, RGBW, RGB+CCT). Provide the strip length in metres and either a preset or the datasheet values (voltage, colour channels, watts per metre at full load). Optional: cut unit, maximum length per feed, number of feeds, power-supply reserve, feed-cable length, material and cross-section, and voltage-drop limit. Planning values from datasheet data, not a manufacturer guarantee; current-carrying capacity, heat and AREI/RGIE rules for SELV, bathrooms and outdoor areas are not checked. The response includes a shareable link that opens the calculation on planelec.be.

colorMode.description: Colour channels: mono, cct, rgb, rgbw or rgbcct. Default: mono.

cutUnitMm.description: Cut unit in mm; the length is rounded down to it.

feedCrossSectionMm2.description: Planned feed-cable cross-section in mm²; omit for a recommendation only.

feedLengthM.description: One-way feed-cable length from power supply to strip in m. Default: 5.

feeds.description: Planned number of feed points; defaults to the minimum.

locale.description: Language of source titles and links (nl, fr, de, en). Defaults to the server setting.

maxFeedDropPercent.description: Feed-cable voltage-drop limit in percent (planning assumption). Default: 3.

maxRunM.description: Manufacturer's maximum strip length per feed in m. Default: 5.

powerPerMeterW.description: Power per metre in W with all channels at full brightness. Default: 14.4.

preset.description: Typical strip class as starting values; explicit fields override it.

voltage.description: Strip nominal voltage in V DC. Default: 24.

name: calculate_led_strip
title: Calculate an LED strip: current, power supply, feed points
